name: toc
need: Jump between the sections of a long page and see which one is being read: a table of contents beside the content or a bar of anchors over it, sticky

--ds-toc-height.description: a link of the column at size md and comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

--ds-toc-bar-height.description: a link of `.ds-toc--bar` at size md and comfortable, as high as a tab

--ds-toc-padding-x.description: a link's side padding at size md (4px per size step; a bar's link `--ds-space-1` more)

--ds-toc-font.description: the type of a link (always at the regular weight; the current one takes the label weight)

--ds-toc-indicator-width.description: the bar of the current link: on the column's line, under the link in a bar

--ds-toc-indicator-color.description: the bar of the current link: on the column's line, under the link in a bar

--ds-toc-top.description: where a sticky column stops below the top of its scroller

--ds-toc-bg.description: the ground under a sticky bar, so the content scrolls away under it

labExempt.DS.toc.current: arithmetic of the scroll-spy (which section is current), no motion of its own
